description: Read and operate CircleCI pipelines, workflows, jobs, contexts, environment variables, schedules and insights (builds, cancel, rerun, approve, trigger) on app.circleci.com in your current tab, using your own logged-in CircleCI session.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated CircleCI user including name, login, and avatar.

tools.name: list_collaborations
tools.description: List all organizations and collaborations the current user belongs to. Returns org IDs, names, slugs, and VCS types.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get project details by project slug. Returns project ID, name, organization, and VCS info.

tools.name: list_pipelines
tools.description: List recent pipelines for a project. Requires project_slug (e.g., "gh/org/repo"). Supports filtering by branch.

tools.name: get_pipeline
tools.description: Get a single pipeline by its UUID. Returns pipeline details including state, trigger info, and VCS data.

tools.name: get_pipeline_config
tools.description: Get the compiled YAML configuration for a pipeline. Returns the source and compiled config.

tools.name: trigger_pipeline
tools.description: Trigger a new pipeline on a project. Specify a branch or tag to build.

tools.name: get_pipeline_workflows
tools.description: List all workflows for a pipeline. Returns workflow names, statuses, and timing.

tools.name: get_workflow
tools.description: Get a single workflow by its UUID. Returns status, timing, and pipeline info.

tools.name: get_workflow_jobs
tools.description: List all jobs in a workflow. Returns job names, statuses, types, and timing.

tools.name: cancel_workflow
tools.description: Cancel a running workflow. The workflow and its running jobs will be stopped.

tools.name: rerun_workflow
tools.description: Rerun a workflow. Optionally rerun only failed jobs or run from a specific job.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get detailed information about a job by project slug and job number. Returns status, timing, duration, parallelism, and web URL.

tools.name: get_job_artifacts
tools.description: List artifacts produced by a job. Returns file paths and download URLs.

tools.name: get_job_tests
tools.description: Get test metadata for a job. Returns test names, results, run times, and failure messages.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a running job by project slug and job number.

tools.name: approve_job
tools.description: Approve a pending approval job in a workflow. Requires the workflow ID and approval request ID.

tools.name: list_contexts
tools.description: List contexts for an organization. Contexts store shared environment variables.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Get a context by its UUID.

tools.name: create_context
tools.description: Create a new context in an organization.

tools.name: delete_context
tools.description: Delete a context and all its environment variables. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_context_env_vars
tools.description: List environment variables in a context. Values are not returned for security.

tools.name: list_env_vars
tools.description: List environment variables for a project. Values are masked.

tools.name: create_env_var
tools.description: Create a project environment variable. The value is stored securely and masked in responses.

tools.name: delete_env_var
tools.description: Delete a project environment variable. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: get_project_workflow_metrics
tools.description: Get summary metrics for all workflows in a project including success rates, durations, and throughput. Covers the last 90 days by default.

tools.name: get_workflow_runs
tools.description: Get recent runs of a specific workflow including status, duration, and branch. Useful for monitoring workflow health.

tools.name: get_workflow_job_metrics
tools.description: Get job-level metrics for a specific workflow including success rates and durations per job.

tools.name: get_flaky_tests
tools.description: Get flaky tests detected in a project. Returns test names, how many times they flaked, and which workflows/jobs they ran in.

tools.name: list_schedules
tools.description: List scheduled pipeline triggers for a project.

tools.name: create_schedule
tools.description: Create a scheduled pipeline trigger for a project. Requires a timetable specifying when to run.

tools.name: update_schedule
tools.description: Update a scheduled pipeline trigger. Only provided fields are changed.

tools.name: delete_schedule
tools.description: Delete a scheduled pipeline trigger. This action cannot be undone.
